title: Applicants — Create / Edit
overviewHtml:
A job candidate. Candidates usually create themselves by registering on the careers site and filling in their profile; HR can also enter them here.

When an application of theirs is set to Joined, the applicant is copied into a new employee record — names, birth date, gender, nationality, religion, marital status, qualification, contact details, Civil ID, joining and probation dates — unless an employee with the same English names and birth date already exists.

The birth date must be in the past, the joining date after the birth date and probation end after joining. An email can belong to one applicant only.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: Title
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Title master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The applicant's title.

Example. Mr

Why it matters. Copied to the new employee when the applicant joins.

fields.label: JoiningDate
fields.html:
What it is. The date the applicant joins, once hired.

Why it matters. Must be filled in before an application can be set to Joined; it becomes the employee's joining date.

fields.label: ProbationEndDate
fields.html:
What it is. The end of probation, once hired.

Why it matters. Must be filled in before an application can be set to Joined.

fields.label: IsAgency
fields.html:
What it is. Whether the applicant came through an agency.

Why it matters. Not read at present — stored for reference.

fields.label: Comments
fields.html: What it is. Free-text notes about this record.

fields.label: CompletionPoints
fields.html:
What it is. How complete the candidate's careers profile is, out of 60 points. Calculated, not typed in.

Example. 35

Why it matters. 5 points each for a photo, Civil ID, nationality, permanent address, birth date, email and mobile, and 25 for at least one CV. Stored when the candidate saves their profile; for information only.

fields.label: IsOnbdStarted
fields.html:
What it is. Whether onboarding may start for this applicant.

Why it matters. Recorded only. Nothing reads it at present.

fields.label: IsOnbdInit
fields.html:
What it is. Whether onboarding has been initiated for this applicant.

Why it matters. Recorded only. Nothing reads it at present.

fields.label: OnbCoordinator
fields.html:
What it is. The employee who coordinates this applicant's onboarding.

Example. Fatima Al-Sabah (HR)

Why it matters. Recorded only. Nothing reads it at present.

fields.label: OnbBuddy
fields.html:
What it is. The employee who looks after the new joiner during onboarding.

Example. Ahmed Khan

Why it matters. Recorded only. Nothing reads it at present.
